content.value: The population of 'X’ region is 2,70,000 and it produces 1,20,000 tons of rice annually. The global average yield of cropland is 1.15 tons/hector/year and the global average capability of cropland is 1.75 tons/hector/year. If X' region also imports 30,000 ha of grape and 15,000 ha of corn annually. What would be the ecological footprint of consumption in per capita for X' region for that year?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2023
